name: Fanaticism is a native spell modifier on Gavels and Horusath Blast only (#3541)
contract: Spell.dbc 805628 ("Fanaticism", SpellFamilyName 33, Passive) has two SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) effects sharing EffectSpellClassMask word 2 = 96, which a repository-wide Spell.dbc scan for family-33 spells shows matches exactly the Gavel of Light/Grace/Wrath chains and the Horusath Blast chain, and nothing else. Effect 0 is EffectMiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS) with EffectBasePoints 19 (amount 20); effect 1 is EffectMiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) with EffectBasePoints -21 (amount -20). Player::ApplySpellMod's SPELLMOD_PCT branch (Player.cpp:10219) gives basevalue = basevalue*totalmul + totalflat: a single +20% modifier makes base 1000 read back 1200, a single -20% modifier makes it read back 800 — exactly the tooltip's 'increases the effectiveness ... and reduces their mana cost ... by 20%'. This is a fully generic native pipeline; no server script exists or is needed.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Gavel of Wrath's effectiveness is increased by 20%
Horusath Blast's effectiveness is increased by 20%
Gavel of Wrath's mana cost is reduced by 20%
Horusath Blast's mana cost is reduced by 20%
An unrelated family-33 spell (Radiant Cascade) is untouched
